A lightweight CLI wrapper for GitHub Copilot CLI

┌───────────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Command                               │ Description                          │
├───────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤
│ list                                  │ List all available profiles          │
│                                       │ (read-only)                          │
│ manage                                │ Interactive profile management       │
│                                       │ (Use/Remove/Add/Import/MCP)          │
│ mcp-compat <profile> [--action        │ Set or reset MCP compatibility       │
│ set|reset|all|none]                   │ servers for an Azure BYOK/proxy      │
│                                       │ profile                              │
│ remove [profiles...]                  │ Remove one or more profiles          │
│                                       │ (interactive multi-select)           │
│ use <profile> [args...]               │ Switch to a specific profile and run │
│                                       │ gh copilot                           │
│ last [args...]                        │ Use the last used profile and run gh │
│                                       │ copilot                              │
│ default [args...]                     │ Use the default Copilot profile      │
│ add                                   │ Add or update a profile              │
│                                       │ interactively                        │
│ import-foundry [options]              │ Import profiles from Foundry/Azure   │
│                                       │ OpenAI deployments                   │
│ help                                  │ Show this help message               │
└───────────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────┘

Passthrough flags (forwarded to gh copilot, applies to use / last / default):
┌─────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Flag                        │ Description                                │
├─────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ -p / --prompt <text>        │ Run non-interactively with a prompt        │
│ --allow-all-tools           │ Allow all tools (auto-injected in -p mode) │
│ --allow-all / --yolo        │ Allow all tools and operations             │
│ --allow-tool <name>         │ Allow only a specific named tool           │
│ --deny-tool <name>          │ Deny a specific named tool                 │
│ --disable-mcp-server <name> │ Disable a named MCP server                 │
│ --disable-builtin-mcps      │ Disable all built-in MCP servers           │
└─────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────┘

import-foundry options:
┌──────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Option                   │ Description                                       │
├──────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ --account <name>         │ Limit import to a single named account            │
│ --resource-group <rg>    │ Resource group of the account (required with      │
│                          │ --account)                                        │
│ --subscription <id|name> │ Scope discovery to a specific subscription        │
│ --mode each|all          │ Prompt per deployment (each) or add all without   │
│                          │ prompts (all)                                     │
│ --all                    │ Shorthand for --mode all                          │
└──────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Azure BYOK MCP compat mode
  On first interactive launch of an Azure BYOK profile, you are prompted to 
select which MCP servers to
  disable (to avoid provider tool-count limits). The selection is saved as 
mcpCompatServers on the
  profile and reused on every subsequent run. Remove the field from config to 
re-prompt.
  Default candidates: foundry-mcp, context7, msx-mcp, azure, workiq, 
powerbi-remote
  Set CBMS_DISABLE_MCP_COMPAT=off to skip compat mode entirely.

Examples:
  copilot-byok-model-switcher list
  copilot-byok-model-switcher manage
  copilot-byok-model-switcher mcp-compat azure-gpt --action reset
  copilot-byok-model-switcher remove
  copilot-byok-model-switcher remove azure-gpt ollama-local
  copilot-byok-model-switcher use azure-gpt
  copilot-byok-model-switcher use azure-gpt -p "create a function"
  copilot-byok-model-switcher use azure-gpt -p "fix the failing tests"
  copilot-byok-model-switcher use azure-gpt -p "refactor this" 
--allow-tool=write
  copilot-byok-model-switcher last -p "explain this code"
  copilot-byok-model-switcher default
  copilot-byok-model-switcher add
  copilot-byok-model-switcher import-foundry
  copilot-byok-model-switcher import-foundry --all
  copilot-byok-model-switcher import-foundry --account myfoundry 
--resource-group my-rg --all
  copilot-byok-model-switcher import-foundry --subscription 
00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --all
